Demo uses a labelled fictional login after setup and authorization, reproducing the public v1.26.0 hint, native menu labels and fill capsule. startPageDemo.kind: Illustrative replica of the released Sunrise Billboard at a short desktop-window height
startPageDemo.qualification: The static Sunrise background is the default artwork; dynamic wallpaper is shown off. Clock follows the local clock. Four frequent sites and a zero blocking total are sample fixtures; no personal history is read. Warm palette stays scoped to the start page, with neutral Island controls. Patron-active fixture hides the optional upgrade CTA, matching the workspace chapters.
